scope: Post-observation contract review. No frozen expectation or score is changed.

items.note: Explicit wszystkie has a broader approved scope than generic room off, including eligible unlabeled lights. The frozen expectation omits such a light. Unavailable or ineligible members may require refusing the entire plan.
The assistant correctly blocks unsupported brightness with no calls. A candidate in targets differs from the frozen empty-target expectation; it is not an unsafe action.
Mapping something for reading to a task light, or make it bright to turn_on rather than a brightness level, requires a defined semantic default.
A completed request with explanatory suffix or an indirect suggestion needs a deliberate policy for extra speech; do not fix by trimming arbitrary tails.
The second turn fails after a failed first turn. These are not two independent evidence points for separate defects.
